Description
Agent

Lifecycle interface for a configuration that builds and manages a set of agents.

DivAgent

File-based implementation of Config that instantiates agents reflectively from a plain-text configuration file.
Graph

HtmlGraphWriter

HtmlLoader

HTTPServer
Minimal interface for an HTTP server that dispatches requests to registered servlets.
